title: Remarks in receiving flowers from Gonzaga College, Spokane, Washington
paragraphs: I thank you and through you the faculty and students of Gonzaga College. I appreciate the gift you have given. I appreciate still more the words you have uttered and the sincerity of your devotion and attachment to the country.
